---
title: "Vertical-gradient sign conventions"
description: "Calculate paired vertical gradients with an explicit numerator, denominator, and sign interpretation."
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
---

For absolute representative elevations, vertical separation is upper minus
lower elevation. The upward-driving gradient is `(lower_head-upper_head) /
vertical_separation`. `ps_vertical_gradient()` can return upward- or
downward-positive values and always records the convention. Reversed, zero, or
unidentified separations fail. A hydraulic gradient indicates driving
potential; it is not groundwater flux.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ps_vertical_gradient(upper_head=10, lower_head=12,
                     upper_elevation=100, lower_elevation=80,
                     positive="upward")
```
